name: TrendRadar
description: Aggregates trending lists from 11 mainstream platforms and RSS feeds, filters them by keyword, pushes digests to chat and email channels, and exposes the data to AI clients over MCP.

skills.name: Trending List Aggregation
skills.description: Collects hot lists from 11 platforms such as Zhihu, Weibo, Douyin, and Bilibili, plus custom platforms.

skills.name: RSS Feed Monitoring
skills.description: Crawls RSS and Atom feeds with the same keyword grouping and freshness filtering as trending lists.

skills.name: Push Modes
skills.description: Sends daily summary, current ranking, or incremental-only digests on a per-day schedule.

skills.name: MCP Analysis
skills.description: Lets MCP clients query and analyze the locally accumulated news data in natural language.

skills.name: Multi-Channel Push
skills.description: Pushes AI-generated content to Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, email, and other channels in one call.
